scheme_name: Scheme Of Assistance To Persons With Disabilities For Purchase/Fitting Of Aids And Appliances
other_conditions: Disability percentage must be 40% or higher
Applicant must not have received assistance for the same purpose in the last 3 years (1 year for children below 12)
If the applicant is a child below 12 years, the restriction period is reduced to one year
Monthly income of applicant (or parents/guardians in case of dependents) must not exceed ₹15,000
benefits_summary: Financial assistance for the purchase/fitting of hearing aids, artificial limbs and other appliances.
